title: Diagonal selection: a diagonal of a double sequence of currents converges weakly to the iterated limit under uniform local mass bounds
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ. For k, i ∈ ℕ let V_{k,i} ⊆ ℝ^P be arbitrary sets and A_{k,i} ∈ 𝒟_n(V_{k,i}) (GeometricCurrentOn (V_{k,i}) n); for k ∈ ℕ let W_k ⊆ ℝ^P be arbitrary sets and Z_k ∈ 𝒟_n(W_k); let C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P). Assume: (H1) for every k ∈ ℕ and every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ n), currentEval(A_{k,i}, ω) → currentEval(Z_k, ω) as i → ∞; (H2) Z_k ⇀ C in ℝ^P (ConvergesWeakly Zs C, i.e. currentEval(Z_k, ω) → C(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P)); (H3) for every R ∈ ℕ there are k₀ ∈ ℕ and Γ ∈ [0, ∞) (Γ ≠ ∞) with M_{B_{R+1}(0)}(C) ≤ Γ such that, for every k ≥ k₀, for all sufficiently large i, B_{R+1}(0) ⊆ V_{k,i} and M_{B_{R+1}(0)}(A_{k,i}) ≤ Γ. Then there is a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ with A_{k,φ(k)} ⇀ C in ℝ^P, i.e. ConvergesWeakly (fun k ↦ A_{k,φ(k)}) C. Here B_r(0) is the open ball, M_W = massOn, and currentEval(T, ω) = T(ω) if ω is a test form whose tsupport lies in the domain of T, and 0 otherwise.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Vs : ℕ → ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (As : (k i : ℕ) → GeometricCurrentOn (Vs k i) n) (Ws : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (Zs : (k : ℕ) → GeometricCurrentOn (Ws k) n) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ (k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), Tendsto (fun i => currentEval (As k i) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) atTop (𝓝 (currentEval (Zs k) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)))) → ConvergesWeakly Zs C → (∀ R : ℕ, ∃ (k₀ : ℕ) (Γ : ℝ≥0∞), Γ ≠ ∞ ∧ C.massOn (ball 0 ((R : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ Γ ∧ ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k → ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ball (0 : Euclid P) ((R : ℝ) + 1) ⊆ Vs k i ∧ (As k i).massOn (ball 0 ((R : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ Γ) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ConvergesWeakly (fun k => As k (φ k)) C
